subject.title: Manual context clearing for tool results

question: Should OpenClaw add caller-directed tool-result clearing as destructive transcript rewrite, model-context-only masking, or recoverable archival, and which CLI, agent, and tool-call adapters should expose that contract?
rationale: The feature changes core session lifecycle semantics across persistence, replay, compaction, restart recovery, and agent authority, so automation should not choose the product and safety contract.

options.title: Design canonical archive/clear contract
options.body: Define one lifecycle operation with stable ids, auth, persistence, recovery, and replay semantics before adding CLI or agent-facing adapters.

options.title: Keep automatic pruning only
options.body: Decline manual clearing for now and improve docs or heuristics around TTL pruning, truncation, compaction, /new, and /reset.

options.title: Implement narrow destructive clear
options.body: Add only a targeted clear-by-id operation and explicitly accept minimal recovery and audit semantics.

recommendation.title: Design canonical archive/clear contract
recommendation.body: Define one lifecycle operation with stable ids, auth, persistence, recovery, and replay semantics before adding CLI or agent-facing adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent cache-TTL pruning history and product-review fit for this issue family.
